verdict: BLOCK for acceptance (not a code-quality block; no CRITICAL defect found)

findings.finding: The shared client fixture runs TestClient(app) with the full lifespan, starting OCR/EVTX/telemetry workers and a Redis pub/sub listener from default settings; no disposable-target guard.
findings.impact: Running the suite with the operational stack up can consume real Redis streams and seed the real database.
findings.openCodeEvidence: conftest.py:94-98 uses 'with TestClient(app)'; backend/main.py lifespan awaits ocr/evtx/telemetry worker.start(); no EIMS_TEST guard in main.py

findings.finding: AUTH_MODE defaults to demo; in demo mode protected routes return an identity without credentials; token-validation errors fall back to demo.
findings.impact: A default deployment accepts anonymous telemetry writes; only the production boot guard prevents it.
findings.openCodeEvidence: config.py:19 ENVIRONMENT default development; config.py:53 AUTH_MODE default demo; config.py:94-112 production refusal

findings.finding: Hardcoded credentials, anonymous-public MinIO bucket, all service ports published on all interfaces, Redis without auth, PgBouncer AUTH_TYPE plain.
findings.impact: OCR manifests are world-readable if the stack is reachable; test_compose_security_audit asserts these known findings.
findings.blocksAcceptance: NO for local dev; YES for any non-local use
findings.openCodeEvidence: docker-compose.yml inspected; tests/test_compose_security_audit.py encodes the same expectations

findings.finding: 'Immutable, tamper-resistant' appears only in model docstrings; no database trigger, REVOKE, hash chain or signature exists in any migration.
findings.impact: An operator with DB access can edit or delete audit rows undetected.
findings.openCodeEvidence: grep over migrations/versions found 0 CREATE TRIGGER / REVOKE / prev_hash constructs

findings.finding: The ledger claims a single migration head a3d6f1e8c295 and carries PASS rows; the actual chain continues six revisions to c4e8a1f7b932. Repository-state counts in the ledger are stale.
findings.impact: A reader of the ledger alone sees PASS rows that look current.

findings.finding: Alters ai_knowledge.embedding from vector(768) to vector(384) using 'embedding::vector(384)'.
findings.impact: The upgrade fails on populated rows because pgvector rejects a dimension-changing cast; downgrade has the same problem.
findings.openCodeEvidence: read lines 19-36; upgrade and downgrade both use a direct dimension cast

findings.finding: A missing outbox table is swallowed; source evidence commits and the incident intent is lost with only a log line.
findings.impact: Running new code before the outbox migration silently drops incidents.

findings.finding: Dedupe key uses a fixed time bucket while classification uses a sliding window.
findings.impact: Events across a bucket edge can create duplicate incidents.

findings.finding: Heartbeat timestamp defaults to now() and the idempotency key hashes the payload after the default is applied.
findings.impact: A retry without a timestamp produces a duplicate heartbeat.

findings.finding: Provider exceptions are swallowed with status success; totals reflect inspected rows; ties are not stable across pages.
findings.impact: Silently partial results, wrong totals, duplicated or skipped rows.

findings.finding: LIKE wildcards are not escaped and the query casts JSONB to text with ilike over windows_event_logs.
findings.impact: A '%' query matches everything and forces a sequential scan on the hot table.

findings.finding: ORDER BY time DESC without a tie-breaker, offset paging, naive datetime bounds.
findings.impact: Unstable pages and ambiguous bounds.

findings.finding: WinlogMetadata is extra=allow with no size or depth cap on the HTTP route.
findings.impact: Oversized JSONB can be enqueued; metadata can spoof source_network_ip.

findings.finding: mTLS verification format-checks a client-supplied header; trust depends on a proxy stripping it.
findings.impact: Direct requests with any well-formed header are accepted if no proxy enforces it.

findings.finding: TRUNCATE ... CASCADE runs against the default database with no confirmation or target guard.
findings.impact: Accidental run wipes operational data.

findings.finding: An untracked scratch script rewrites tests/test_analyzer_reliability.py in place and writes tests/_field_fixture_veeam.py.
findings.impact: Running it mutates tracked tests and invalidates the freeze.
findings.openCodeEvidence: script body read; target file is tracked and imported by the rewritten test

findings.finding: Namespace validation only logs a warning; alert stream keys are outside approved prefixes; Redis uses volatile-lru.
findings.impact: Fail-closed on XADD, but key hygiene is weaker than implied.

findings.finding: Unclassified errors are treated as transient and never dead-lettered; DLQ entries are truncated at 2048 chars.
findings.impact: Unbounded retry; some DLQ entries cannot be replayed.

findings.finding: The real taskkill graceful-then-forced path is only exercised through injected StopAction in tests.
findings.impact: Claimed process-level behaviour is untested.

findings.finding: The two monitor suites are separate, fixtures are synthetic and use %TEMP%, and analyzer accuracy is honestly reported as INSUFFICIENT_DATA with no accuracy percentage claim anywhere.
findings.impact: None.
